vocab-algae:example-1.text: Green algae covered the surface of the pond during the summer.
vocab-algae:example-1.translation: 夏の間、池の表面は緑色の藻で覆われた。

vocab-algae:example-3.text: Too much light can make algae grow quickly in a fish tank.

vocab-courtyard:example-1.text: Students eat lunch in the courtyard when the weather is nice.
